lines.text: They said it can’t be done, you can’t make Bitcoin smart

Now we here at the cutting edge

and ZK-proofs now

and staking pools that you can join
And if that ain't your cup of tea
Just use it as money
The scaling’s great, there’s no issue there
A 1000X advantage almost seems unfair
UTXO local state
And me?

and ZK-proofs now

and ZK-proofs now

and staking pools that you can join

that someone might as well be you
